summary: Replace the heavy three-panel dark dashboard with a compact classic Windows Messenger-inspired roster and conversation UI; preserve all Social, LoopRD and developer authorization behavior.

implemented.title: Classic messenger window design and responsive roster
implemented.summary: Slim Windows-style chrome, buddy groups with search/collapse, lightweight conversation transcript, traditional menus, compact game alerts and mobile roster/conversation navigation. Existing server actions retained; no new database migration.
operator_checks: Open the new Windows NSIS client and verify the roster is narrow and separate-looking from the conversation; no permanent right game sidebar or message bubbles.
Sign in and open public lobby and friend DMs; verify Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, roster search and collapsing groups work.
Click menus and toolbar actions for Contacts, Games, Alerts, Portrait, Options and Logout; verify each acts or reports a clear error.
Resize to mobile width or install the Android build; confirm switching between contacts and conversation without clipped controls.
Verify non-developer users have no Admin/Debug controls; grant operator permission and confirm the existing toggle still works; revoke to hide it.
Compare against a real LoopRD Social v0.3.1+ deployment and confirm registration, messages, games and portraits were not affected.

remaining.title: Account recovery and hardened public registration
remaining.summary: Social-owned password recovery and device management, optional email verification/invite controls, abuse prevention, security review and production readiness remain to be implemented. External OIDC not required.

remaining.title: Private groups and game invitations
remaining.summary: Buddy list/direct messages are implemented in this pass. Group conversation membership, game invitations, moderation and game ticket authorization still need Social and game-side contracts.

remaining.title: Android background push and turn delivery
remaining.summary: Turn notifications work while the client is running; provide Social-owned device push registration and a push provider to wake Android after app termination.

remaining.title: Native build and device acceptance
remaining.summary: Rebuild Windows NSIS and Android debug APK for v0.3.2; perform visual and device acceptance. Source checks are not native build proof.

remaining.title: Game activity integration
remaining.summary: Each game hosted on the selected LoopRD server must implement its own turn-activity contract for automatic alerts; the Social app cannot fabricate turns.

remaining.title: Secure persistent device login
remaining.summary: Currently device session token is memory-only; add native OS-secure storage with explicit remembered-device management and logout/remote revoke controls.
